application.transport_scope: complete source bytes/frames/work/transaction memory; physical data and ACK validation restricted to capture prefix
application.scope: functional byte/event acceptance, not numerical model or calibrated GPU/provider performance

recovery.complete_scope: complete denotes ACKed published prefix; connection persists until explicit Close
recovery.identity_scope: message_id in records and fault rules means persistent stream ID; sequences cover the whole connection

selective_summary.scope: bounded byte-only selective-repeat reference, not IRN reproduction, modern GIN or hardware calibration; source uses received feedback only
selective_summary.wire_format: MSR1 16-byte big-endian magic/begin/end/valid after native ACK header; actual model bytes, not production RoCE
